card.name: Linking words before patient-group or weight terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation just before a patient descriptor or weight value, such as the space after 'Less than' before '80 kg', or 'or' after 'cachectic,' before 'debilitated'.

modes.label: Weight cutoff
modes.description: The blank space after 'Less than' just before a weight in kg in dosing tables.
modes.example: RYBREVANT FASPRO as a single agent Less than<< >>80 kg 1,60

modes.label: Frail patient lists
modes.description: The word 'or' ending a list of frail patient types, right before 'debilitated'.
modes.example: Life-Threatening Respiratory Depression in Patients with Chronic Pulmonary Disease or in Elderly, Cachectic,<< or>> Debilitated Patients: Monitor closely,

modes.label: Older patients comma
modes.description: A comma after 'older patients' before a clause about who is more prone to adverse effects.
modes.example: should be considered for older patients<<,>> who are more prone to the adverse effects
